priorityList: Ensure your pet is summoned before combat starts.
Use Bestial Wrath on cooldown to maximize uptime.
Cast Wild Thrash on cooldown as your primary Pack Leader ability.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath is about to come off cooldown (less than 1.5 seconds remaining) to maximize cooldown reduction.
Cast Kill Command as your top priority attack whenever it is available.
Use Cobra Shot if the Hogstrider buff is active and Wild Thrash is currently on cooldown.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain 3 stacks of Frenzy on your pet or to avoid reaching 2 charges.
Use Cobra Shot as a filler if Kill Command and Wild Thrash are on cooldown and you have excess Focus.
Activate offensive Racial abilities like Berserking, Blood Fury, or Ancestral Call during Bestial Wrath.
Use your Combat Potion during Bestial Wrath to align with your highest damage window.
Sync on-use trinkets (such as Algethar Puzzle Box or Void Execution Mandate) with Bestial Wrath.
If using Algethar Puzzle Box, use it slightly before Bestial Wrath (when BW has less than 2 seconds remaining on cooldown).
